title: Due to Insecure Storage of Sensitive Information in SAP Web Dispatcher and Internet Communication Manager, an attacker…
description: CVE-2026-89125 describes a vulnerability in SAP Web Dispatcher and Internet Communication Manager where sensitive information is stored insecurely. An attacker with administrative privileges could access this stored sensitive data, potentially correlating credentials across users and deployments. This exposure could lead to unauthorized access to affected systems. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality significantly, with lesser impacts on integrity and availability.
